decisions.statement: A command answers and this module prints.
An answer is waited for before the report is printed.
The report and the refusals are out before the exit code ends the process.
An answer is written by writes that return before the exit code is given.
The report is printed apart from the refusals.
An exit code says which kind of thing went wrong.
What a run is outside the command line is gathered here and handed to the command.
A throw of no known kind is caught here and answered as one of no known kind.
No function here is the guard a command's body runs inside.

definition: the name on the path answered, printed and given an exit code
